documents: The ledger appends every event as an HMA1 frame and assigns a monotonic LSN.
Projections replay the ledger from a checkpoint and rebuild the derived stores.
The vector lane stores quantized int8 embeddings under a single space identity.
The lexical lane ranks candidates with BM25 over the tokenized corpus.
Fusion combines lane rankings with reciprocal rank fusion into a composite score.
The activation bundle carries hits, a retrieval manifest and four health bytes.
The retrieval manifest records the manifest id, included provenance and support provenance.
Support provenance lists the ledger LSNs that produced a derived record.
Paired evidence resolves a summary hit back to the original observation.
The relation lane ranks relationship representations directly against the query.
A relationship representation is the deterministic text a relationship embedding is built from.
Consolidation mints a memory from the ledger range above the scope extraction watermark.
FSRS retrievability decays with elapsed time and rises again after a successful recall.
The attention engine decides whether to notify, ask the user, start work or suppress.
Quiet hours batch interruptions instead of notifying the actor immediately.
The daemon exposes fourteen MCP verbs over a stdio transport.
The remember verb appends an observation and embeds it into the document space.
The activate verb composes a bundle and returns it as canonical HMA1 bytes.
An embedding event records the target LSN and the model provenance of the encoder.
The cross encoder rerank is off by default and needs measured evidence before it is enabled.
The alignment boost multiplies a fused score by an integer factor in Q16 fixed point.
Geometry math stays integer only and never leaves the declared factor band.
The HNSW index answers approximate nearest neighbour queries over the vector lane.
Graph edges assert a relation between a source entity and a target entity.
The checkpoint bridge maps ledger event kinds onto projection event kinds.
Retention and sensitivity travel with every event and gate what may be recalled.
Derived inference authority never becomes observed authority.
The eval gate reports judge free metrics beside judged metrics for one slice.
